title: Track 3 external-capability handoff
purpose: Machine-readable acceptance contracts for the empirical capabilities that a public repository cannot manufacture.
semantics: UNKNOWN means required external evidence is unavailable to the public repository.
A protocol is not an empirical observation.
Missing public records are not evidence of absence.
Queue, contract, annual power and interval meter measurements remain distinct.

blockers.name: Global transaction-level accelerator accounting
blockers.missing_evidence: Globally complete production, sale, resale and transfer records with stable asset identifiers and timestamps.
blockers.required_authority: Manufacturers, distributors, resellers, owners and competent authorities.
blockers.acceptance_test: Every in-scope transaction is represented or explicitly excluded with a reason; overlap and duplicate rules are reproducible; provenance is retained.

blockers.name: Authorized physical inspection
blockers.missing_evidence: Lawful inspection observations with authority, access basis, equipment observations and chain of custody.
blockers.required_authority: Authorized inspectors under an agreed mandate.
blockers.acceptance_test: Each inspection has immutable ID, authority/access basis, evidence hashes, equipment scope, exceptions and independent review state.

blockers.name: Global serial-number continuity
blockers.missing_evidence: Global asset/serial ledger covering acquisition, transfer, staging, service, decommissioning and final disposition.
blockers.acceptance_test: No in-scope serial has an unexplained lifecycle transition; concurrent-location conflicts are resolved or explicitly ambiguous.

blockers.name: Verified decommissioning and recycling
blockers.missing_evidence: Compute-specific destruction/recycling events independently corroborated to equipment scope.
blockers.required_authority: Owners, recyclers/destruction providers and independent verifier.
blockers.acceptance_test: Disposition evidence is linked to equipment scope and independent verification state; unsupported claims remain UNKNOWN.

blockers.name: Closed statistical audit population and realized sample
blockers.missing_evidence: Externally fixed threshold, closed sampling frame, reproducible random sample and observed failures.
blockers.acceptance_test: Population hash, eligibility rule, seed, sample, failure definition, outcomes and calculation reproduce independently.

blockers.name: Comprehensive covert-site intelligence and discovery
blockers.missing_evidence: Coverage capable of discovering deliberately concealed facilities outside the public-reference universe.
blockers.required_authority: Lawful intelligence, remote-sensing and investigative partners.
blockers.acceptance_test: Closed detection universe, acquisition coverage, candidate adjudication, error characterization and audit trail are defined.

blockers.name: Independent verification governance
blockers.missing_evidence: Independent authority, access rights, disputes, confidentiality, enforcement and conflict-of-interest procedures.
blockers.required_authority: Participating states/institutions under a formal mandate.
blockers.acceptance_test: Governance instrument defines authority, independence, audit access, dispute path, evidentiary standard, publication and enforcement procedures.

completion_semantics: The public repository is complete only as engineering/research infrastructure. Empirical closure remains UNKNOWN until these acceptance tests are met with external evidence.
